data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 古堡四柱床的血之初拥
data.description: 挂满深色帷幔的古典四柱大床上，吊带黑丝与束腰勾勒出妖异至极的曲线。雾枝骑坐在对方腰间，獠牙刺入颈项吸吮血液的同时，下身紧紧贴合在一起，发出既痛苦又沉沦的喘息。
data.location: grand gothic bedchamber on ornate four-poster canopy bed with heavy velvet drapery
data.action: 雾枝骑坐在对方腰间，獠牙刺入颈项吸吮血液的同时，下身紧紧贴合在一起，发出既痛苦又沉沦的喘息
data.lighting: flickering candelabra light reflecting off single droplet of blood on pale throat
data.promptProse: Beneath the dark drapes of an antique four-poster bed, Kirie sits astride her partner's lap and bends down to bite his neck with sharp vampire fangs. Soft dim light catches a slender crimson trickle on his skin and her flushed, entranced expression.
data.animaCaption: Straddling her partner's waist on the curtained four-poster bed in a midnight-black velvet corset, lace bra, and gartered sheer stockings, she leans into his throat to sink her fangs with a faint trickle of blood as their hips press tightly together.
data.nsfwProse: Dressed in a black velvet corset with eyelash-lace cups, attached satin garter straps, and sheer black thigh-high stockings, she grinds her hips closely against her partner.
